## Attendance

The Programme Board met in May 2023. Present were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, L. Petrov. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting. The board confirmed that the attendance record was complete and that matters were considered with the appropriate programme representation.

## Performance

The board reviewed operational performance for May 2023. A total of 2494 captures was recorded during the month. Members noted the current backlog of 285 and considered the position in relation to outstanding work and service commitments.

The board also reviewed correspondence performance. There were 50 letters requiring attention. Members agreed that the backlog and letter position should continue to be monitored through the regular performance review, with any material change brought back to the board.

## Items

CHG-0131 Camera firmware 4.2.0 was noted. The board recognised the change and requested that the relevant owner provide an update on implementation and any remaining considerations.

CHG-0152 Patient merge batch applied was also noted. The board recorded the change and requested a further update from the relevant owner, including confirmation that any follow-up work had been addressed.

## Actions

Owners are to report back on CHG-0131 Camera firmware 4.2.0 and CHG-0152 Patient merge batch applied. The performance position, including 2494 captures, backlog of 285 and 50 letters, is to remain under review. Actions will be carried forward to the next meeting.
